subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: After the timeout-recovery defect is repaired, is redacted live WeChat A+B QR-login evidence required for this exact gateway lifecycle change, or may focused lifecycle regressions and required CI serve as merge proof?
rationale: The contributor cannot obtain a real WeChat provider session from the available environment, and only a gateway owner can decide whether that external-provider proof is mandatory for this behavior.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real WeChat A+B QR-login run on the exact head shows account A remains online after account B is added.

options.title: Waive with lifecycle proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the repaired focused gateway regressions and completed required CI as sufficient evidence for this provider-backed handoff.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real WeChat A+B QR-login run on the exact head shows account A remains online after account B is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on the adjacent account-aware gateway reload boundary makes this the strongest evidence-backed routing candidate available.
